question: When the accepted causal cross-industry dispersion state is high, does the worst same-session stock-versus-PIT-industry residual in each sufficiently broad industry subsequently reverse over three sessions?
why_not_a_repeat: The exact unconditional five-session stock reversal, post-shock recovery, and industry-rank continuation families are closed. This experiment uses one-session stock-minus-leave-one-out-industry displacement, the independently accepted high-dispersion state, one representative per industry, and no recovery confirmation. It reads the accepted compact daily panel and does not rerun MKT-DISP-RANK-001/002/003/004/005.

population.security_universe: exact accepted Cycle-015 daily eligible liquid universe

predictor.signal: step_return minus industry_return_loo on completed session t
predictor.selection: within every supported PIT industry, choose the one security with the lowest signal; ties break by symbol ascending
predictor.earliest_execution: next legal session open; screen response begins with t+1 action-aware step and does not assume a t-bar fill

response.screen_return: expm1(sum of exact consecutive t+1 through t+3 action-aware step_return))
response.candidate: equal-weight mean of one lowest-residual security per supported industry
response.event_control: equal-weight mean of all response-complete eligible securities on the same date
response.opposite_arm: equal-weight mean of one highest-residual security per supported industry; diagnostic only
response.event_schedule: all supported high-dispersion dates for the information screen; no portfolio capital ledger is opened

temporal_sequence.fixed_validation: 2022-01-01 through 2023-12-31, opened only if every generation gate passes

post_result_action.if_both_gates_pass: Freeze one separate next-open executable portfolio contract before reading portfolio PnL.
post_result_action.if_generation_fails: Close the exact high-dispersion stock-relative one-session reversal family; do not open validation or change state, horizon, selection depth, confirmation, or sign.
post_result_action.if_validation_fails: Reject the exact translation without replay or rescue.

prohibited: threshold, horizon, Top-N, confirmation, state, sign, or control search
Strategy A or Industry-Consensus Q1 modification
portfolio PnL before both information gates pass
validation opening after a generation failure
